seed_recipe.world_start: 7000000000 + run_seed*500000000 + iteration*10000000; take first games seeds passing world_split(seed)==train
seed_recipe.topology_matters: Collector/worker count, chunking and historical sampling path affect stochastic trajectories.
seed_recipe.single_collector_resume: Trainer reseeds torch at process start rather than restoring its previous sampling stream.

optimizer_recipe: New PPO stage creates fresh AdamW; --resume restores latest.pt moments within that run. Named iter checkpoints and distilled checkpoints have optimizer_state=None.
round2_label_parent_note: Labels smith85_elite90_distilled were collected with distill_smith85_i36/distilled.pt, then fitted to ooc_pfd_lam1/iter_0012.pt. The two checkpoint inputs intentionally differ.
gaps: No exact per-launch source binding for all RL-debug starts/resumes; early ooc_main_s1 resumes do not log full configurations.
Online PPO trajectories, per-world training fault records and sampled action sequences are discarded rather than archived.
latest.pt stores weights/Adam state/iteration/steps but no RNG/config/source/native/data provenance; only the latest such state is retained.
Named RL-debug checkpoints copy stale RNG and original parent/data/native/optimizer metadata from their template. Do not treat those fields as current evidence.
Current build/runtime hashes are observed now, not proof every historical job used them.
Historical time-bounded initial training and operational faults can change sample/update counts even with the same recipe.
Artifacts are gitignored and spread across dependent worktrees. This JSON preserves identities/settings, not checkpoint/data/binary bytes.
No fresh end-to-end retraining/parity experiment or independent backup was verified in this audit.
next_preservation_steps: Create and verify a durable bundle of original training artifacts plus RL-debug checkpoints, label shards, logs/config/queue, source revisions, native builds and runtime lock.
Bind future launches/resumes to immutable source/native/data/parent hashes and effective config; save current RNG states and full resume state at retained checkpoints.
Label the existing successful sequence as a historical recipe; validate a fixed-source reproduction with bounded smoke/continuation parity before claiming exact replay.
